collections.title: Women writers
collections.intro: Novels, poems and essays by women, from Jane Austen to Margaret Atwood: some of them founding texts of feminism, some simply books that changed what a woman could write about. Each tile is one cover, chosen by eye; the wall behind it shows the rest.

collections.title: SF Masterworks
collections.intro: The first, numbered run of the SF Masterworks (1999–2007): seventy-three science fiction novels that Millennium and Gollancz reprinted as classics of the genre, in the order of their numbers. Behind each cover is the wall of the other faces we found for the book.
